name: Stack Overflow
subtitle: Response to your response. Nobody's quite sure what resolves next — that's the point.

identity.mission: An Izzet spellslinger built around the stack itself. Copies, redirections, and rebounds pile effects on top of one another until no one at the table — the pilot included — is quite sure what will resolve next. The deck should feel like controlled chaos: brilliant, overclocked, and one trigger away from a cascade of consequences.

pillars.name: The Stack Never Settles
pillars.description: Spells copy, fork, and trigger more spells. The stack is always taller than it looks, and the top of it keeps changing.

pillars.name: Redirect & Misdirect
pillars.description: Change targets, bounce spells back, and make removal hit the wrong thing. Control the question of who and what, not just how much.

pillars.name: Overclocked Genius
pillars.description: The Izzet aesthetic — arcane circuitry, storm-lit laboratories, and mad-scientist confidence. Blue-red brilliance running hot.

chapter_flavor.Commander: The mind that keeps the stack from ever settling.
chapter_flavor.Ramp: Fuel for the next spell, and the next.
chapter_flavor.Draw: More cards, more questions, more responses.
chapter_flavor.Interaction: Counters, redirects, and the wrong target chosen.
chapter_flavor.Threats: When the stack finally resolves your way.
chapter_flavor.Mana Base: The circuitry it all runs on.

identity.selection_rule: Rarity alone never determines the definitive printing.
